Self-hosted libraries for the home page country map (loaded on first hover or focus).
d3.min.js            d3 7.9.0            ISC licence   https://github.com/d3/d3
topojson-client.min.js  topojson-client 3.1.0  ISC licence   https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
countries-110m.json  world-atlas 2.0.2   ISC licence (Natural Earth, public domain)   https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
To update: npm pack d3@7 topojson-client@3 world-atlas@2 and replace these files.
